#b::RunCmd("`"\home\cain-test\.local\bin\cain.exe`" booklister", "Hide")
!g::RunCmd("`"\home\cain-test\.local\bin\cain.exe`" booklister", "Hide")

ToggleMax() {
    try {
        if WinGetMinMax("A") = 1
            WinRestore "A"
        else
            WinMaximize "A"
    }
}

RunCmd(cmd, opts := "") {
    try Run cmd, , opts
    catch as e
        MsgBox "cain could not run:`n" cmd "`n`n" e.Message
}
